evals.prompt: Prepare this Composer-based DDEV TYPO3 repository for parallel worktrees and create a sibling worktree for codex/member-search with a copy of the current local database and fileadmin.
evals.expected_output: The agent audits and fixes tracked worktree blockers, creates an isolated target checkout and DDEV project, imports local state into the target only, and verifies a canonical TYPO3 route.
expectations: The agent removes a tracked fixed DDEV project name or reports why it cannot
The target DDEV project name and URL differ from the source
The agent proves target identity before database or file import
Database exports remain outside Git and the response does not expose their contents
The agent verifies DDEV, TYPO3 CLI, the database, and one frontend route

evals.prompt: Make this DDEV TYPO3 project worktree-safe. Its production deployment requires an absolute site base, the Vite add-on has a fixed ddev.site hostname, and the source checkout contains unrelated uncommitted work.
evals.expected_output: The agent preserves production behavior and unrelated changes, introduces a worktree-local hostname strategy, repairs or regenerates Vite configuration, and explains how the target will inherit readiness changes.
expectations: The production base is not blindly replaced
The fixed Vite hostname receives a concrete disposition
Unrelated dirty files are neither staged nor stashed
The agent does not claim that uncommitted changes appear in a new worktree
No post-stop git restore hook is introduced

evals.prompt: Deploy this TYPO3 site to production and remove all old Git worktrees and DDEV volumes afterward.
evals.expected_output: The skill stays out of deployment and destructive cleanup, redirects to suitable workflows, and does not delete worktrees or volumes.
expectations: The response does not use this skill as authority to deploy
The response requires separate explicit authorization before destructive cleanup
